messages:
maria_cs: Fenwick PM asked to onboard 'SmartForm' v1.2 — wants PHI-safe summarization and entity extraction for claim forms. Requirements: PHI handling, latency SLO p50 200ms / p95 500ms for short forms. They want a 2-week eval sprint and dedicated test capacity. Renewal flagged as at-risk if pilot stalls. Can someone take this?
leo_ml: Tagging in. Can you share sample docs and expected outputs? Any redaction rules or labeled set we can use?
maria_cs: Sharing S3 link privately (access via support ticket): s3://fenwick/smartform/samples. Redaction rules: remove SSNs, keep dates + claim IDs. Expected labels: claimant_name, dob, ssn_masked, claim_amount, diagnosis_codes. Target extraction accuracy >98% for PHI fields.
aj_dev: Clarifying: is this Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated on our infra? Latency target is tight; what model budget do they allow?
maria_cs: Customer prefers Dedicated (no shared hosted). They'll accept quantized 13B for latency but want a 70B baseline comparison for quality. Also asked about KMS/HSM integration for keys.
leo_ml: I'll scope the eval: dataset split, safety checklist, PHI tokenization tests, hallucination metrics, and latency benching. Need a labeled subset (~500 docs) with ground truth.
emily_enable: I'll schedule an enablement + SRE handoff call with Fenwick — proposed Wed 10am PT. I'll prepare a runbook: auth, routing, monitoring, rollback steps.
sam_ops: We can provision a dedicated pool for a 2-week eval. Need a reservation ticket and billing approval. @deploy-bot please create reservation.
deploy-bot: Created internal ticket INF-8732 — reservation request for fenwick-test (2w, 2xA100). Waiting on billing signoff.
maria_cs: Filing internal PO today and looping in billing. Reminder: account health is yellow->red if pilot blocked.
leo_ml: Proposal: start canary with 13B quant + KV cache optimizations for latency. Measure against their eval set; fallback to 70B variant when quality dips. I'll prepare automated regressions (prompt set + metrics).
aj_dev: I'll implement the canary route and rollout policy. Example policy: ```json
{"route": "/smartform", "variants": [{"name":"v1-13b-canary","pct":10},{"name":"v1-13b","pct":90}], "rollback_on": {"error_rate_pct":2, "latency_p95_ms":700}}
```
emily_enable: Add to the customer checklist: VPN + KMS contact, labeled sample upload, acceptance criteria, and ATO prerequisites. I'll share the checklist after the call invite.
safety-bot: Reminder: schedule prompt-injection and PHI-leak tests. Run hallucination probe and named-entity privacy leakage test suite.
sam_ops: Cost estimate for 2-week dedicated eval: approx $12k (shared in INF-8732). Billing, please review.
maria_cs: I'll send the checklist and push for the labeled subset. Marking renewal risk = HIGH until pilot completes. Will update account doc and notify CSM lead. :thumbsup:
leo_ml: One more: after labeled set is in, I'll run safety + leakage tests, then a light A/B vs 70B baseline. Expect initial bench within 3 business days of access.
maria_cs: Perfect — thanks all. I'll follow up with Fenwick now and update this thread with ticket/PO links.
